comments.body: You need a letter about parental support of at least 1750 CHF per month, but it is (to my knowledge) not enforced at all. If one parent is fine with signing it with no intention of paying, the letter itself should not be the problem. Ofc money is still needed to not starve or freeze to death, and if the parents are not paying, you have to come up with something.
comments.author: bbalazs721
